targets.rawSql:
with deltas as (
  select
    source_database,
    inst_id,
    sql_id,
    child_number,
    plan_hash_value,
    max(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) as elapsed_micro_delta,
    max(coalesce(executions, 0)) - min(coalesce(executions, 0)) as executions_delta,
    max(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) - min(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) as buffer_gets_delta,
    max(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) - min(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) as disk_reads_delta,
    max(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) - min(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) as rows_processed_delta,
    max(parsing_schema_name) as parsing_schema_name,
    max(module) as module
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, child_number, plan_hash_value
)
select
  source_database,
  inst_id,
  sql_id,
  child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  executions_delta,
  rows_processed_delta,
  round((elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0) / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 6) as elapsed_seconds_per_exec,
  round(buffer_gets_delta::numeric / nullif(rows_processed_delta, 0), 3) as buffer_gets_per_row,
  round(disk_reads_delta::numeric / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 3) as disk_reads_per_exec,
  parsing_schema_name,
  module,
  left((select t.sql_fulltext from oracle_sql_texts t where t.source_database = deltas.source_database and t.sql_id = deltas.sql_id), 240) as sql_preview
from deltas
where elapsed_micro_delta > 0
order by coalesce((elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0) / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 0) desc
limit 50;

with samples as (
  select
    collected_at,
    source_database,
    inst_id,
    sql_id,
    child_number,
    coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0) as elapsed_time_micro,
    coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0) as cpu_time_micro,
    coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0) as user_io_wait_micro
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
), deltas as (
  select
    collected_at,
    greatest(elapsed_time_micro - coalesce(lag(elapsed_time_micro) over w, elapsed_time_micro), 0) / 1000000.0 as elapsed_seconds,
    greatest(cpu_time_micro - coalesce(lag(cpu_time_micro) over w, cpu_time_micro), 0) / 1000000.0 as cpu_seconds,
    greatest(user_io_wait_micro - coalesce(lag(user_io_wait_micro) over w, user_io_wait_micro), 0) / 1000000.0 as user_io_seconds
  from samples
  window w as (partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, child_number order by collected_at)
)
select collected_at as "time", 'Elapsed' as metric, sum(elapsed_seconds)::double precision as value
from deltas
group by collected_at
union all
select collected_at as "time", 'CPU' as metric, sum(cpu_seconds)::double precision as value
from deltas
group by collected_at
union all
select collected_at as "time", 'User I/O Wait' as metric, sum(user_io_seconds)::double precision as value
from deltas
group by collected_at
order by 1;

select
  source_database,
  inst_id,
  sql_id,
  child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  min(collected_at) as first_seen,
  max(collected_at) as last_seen,
  count(*) as samples,
  max(executions) - min(executions) as executions_delta,
  round((max(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0))) / 1000000.0, 3) as elapsed_seconds_delta,
  round((max(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0))) / 1000000.0, 3) as cpu_seconds_delta,
  max(parsing_schema_name) as parsing_schema_name,
  max(module) as module
from oracle_sql_samples
where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
group by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, child_number, plan_hash_value
order by last_seen desc, elapsed_seconds_delta desc;
